steps.name: core_Radio
visible_text: South bridge / keep L-02A shelter power before touching either battery feed.

Xu Tang: It starts again when the lights go out. I used to count the clicks.
Su Mi: The battery room. The campus branch is already off; this thing has its own supply.
Tang Kui: Do not touch the green cable. That is our kitchen.
Shen: We are outside the north door. This time, nobody waits in there alone.

steps.name: core_Bridge
visible_text: Cut both side feeds during blue cooling windows. Amber lane: move aside. The white bar is the live discharge.

[The green shelter lamp stays on.]
Tang Kui: Still cooking.
Su Mi: That is how you check the power?
Tang Kui: It is a very good test.
Circuit changed / L-02A shelter supply remains on.

steps.name: core_LeftFeed
visible_text: Cut both side feeds during blue cooling windows. Amber lane: move aside. The white bar is the live discharge.

Xu Tang: One less click.
Shen: Keep your eyes on the floor. We heard something moving.
Circuit changed / L-02A shelter supply remains on.

steps.name: core_RightFeed
visible_text: Both feeds isolated / use the north master stop during a blue cooling window.

Su Mi: Both battery feeds are isolated. The middle lane will discharge once more.
Tang Kui: Then pull its teeth out. I am not reheating this a third time.
Circuit changed / L-02A shelter supply remains on.

steps.name: core_MasterStop
visible_text: The backup core is stopped. North door open; extract and go home.
FIELD OPERATION COMPLETE / EXTRACT WHEN READY

[The rotor slows. No new click follows.]
Xu Tang: ...Is that it?
Su Mi: That is it.
Shen: The north door is open. Come home.
Circuit changed / L-02A shelter supply remains on.

steps.name: core_map
visible_text: The backup core is stopped. North door open; extract and go home.

Xu Tang: ...Is that it?
Su Mi: That is it.
Shen: The north door is open. Come home.

steps.name: maintenance_shutdown_debrief
visible_text: MISSION  /  Backup Power / The Last Click

[L-02A is still lit. The test equipment stays dark.]
Su Mi: No restart signal. No backup feed.
Tang Kui: I can hear the pot boiling again.
Xu Tang: I want to hear that.
Shen: Then stop standing in the doorway. All of you.

steps.name: ending_two_actors
visible_text:
Tang Kui, on the radio: Two knocks. I said two.
Su Mi: She knocked three times.
Shen: One was you kicking the door.

steps.name: ending_table
visible_text:
Shen: Leave it.
Xu Tang: Let them argue. It is nice.
[There is room at the table. The soup is still warm.]

visible_text: Tonight, nobody is waiting outside. Return to the table, or head back to base.
